# Mackenzie Design Cup 2026

> The Mackenzie Design Cup is a one-day 3D design competition for TDSB high school students in grades 9 to 12. This year's ran on Monday, November 16, 2026, at Limberlost Place, George Brown Polytechnic, in Toronto. We're the WLMAC 3D Design Club at William Lyon Mackenzie Collegiate Institute, and we run it.

- **How did it go?** 66 students modelled 41 designs in a single day, to a theme revealed at the opening ceremony that morning. Each team presented to a pair of judges, and the top five were announced at the closing ceremony.
- **Who won?** First place went to Prosthetic Eye, second to I.M. Maddy (Intuitive Medicine), third to Automatic Food Maker, fourth to Trialcore (survival kit) and fifth to Skintifity. Every design, winners first, is at www.macdesigncup.ca/submissions.
- **Where can I see the designs?** All 41 designs are at www.macdesigncup.ca/submissions. Open one to see the team's pictures and turn their 3D model around.
- **I placed. When do I get my prize?** Prizes are on their way, and we'll be in touch with winners by email. If you placed and haven't heard from us in 1 to 2 weeks, email wlmac.3ddesignclub@gmail.com.
- **When will photos and video be posted?** Soon. Our photographers are sorting through them so that only people who gave media consent appear.
- **Will there be another Mackenzie Design Cup?** We'd love to run it again. Nothing is confirmed for next year yet. Email wlmac.3ddesignclub@gmail.com to hear first, or to back the next one as a sponsor, judge or mentor.
- **What software did students use?** Onshape was the most common, then Tinkercad, Blender and Fusion 360. Any 3D software was allowed.
- **Who could enter?** Any TDSB high school student in grades 9 to 12, with a teacher from their own school there on the day. Entry was free, and students competed solo or in teams of up to 4.
- **How can I prepare for next time?** Our free study guides are at www.macdesigncup.ca/resources: one each for Blender, Fusion 360 and Onshape, written by the WLMAC 3D Design Club.
- **How do I contact the organizers?** Email the WLMAC 3D Design Club at wlmac.3ddesignclub@gmail.com. We're the student club at William Lyon Mackenzie Collegiate Institute that runs the Mackenzie Design Cup, and we read everything.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.macdesigncup.ca/): 66 TDSB students modelled 41 designs in one day at our 3D design competition on November 16, 2026, for $10,000+ in prizes. See every design and the winners.
- [Registration](https://www.macdesigncup.ca/register): Teachers, register your whole group on one form. Students, sign yourself up, then bring a teacher from your school with you on Monday, November 16, 2026.
- [Resources](https://www.macdesigncup.ca/resources): Free study guides for our 3D design competition on Monday, November 16, 2026: modelling, assemblies and rendering in Blender, Fusion 360 and Onshape.
- [Partner](https://www.macdesigncup.ca/partner): Put your company in front of TDSB students who design in 3D. We need sponsors, mentors, judges and speakers for Monday, November 16, 2026, in Toronto.
